query:
What was decided about the Christmas dinner menu, and did all family members seem equally happy with that plan?

Options:
A. Adaora
B. Chidi
C. Emeka
D. Ngozi
context:
[1] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t0 @2025-02-03T14:22:00) Adaora I will be making egusi, jollof, the full thing. You know I cook for three days before Christmas 😂❤️
[2] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:26:00) Adaora I am cooking! You don't need to bring anything 😂❤️
[3] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t6 @2025-02-24T19:09:00) Of course I will make moi moi! I always do. You will also eat the goat Adaora 😂 Tobenna what do you want?
[4] (about=Adaora, episodic, t6 @2025-02-24T19:08:00) Mum could you maybe do something with beans this year? Like moi moi? Or akara?
[5] (about=Adaora, episodic, t6 @2025-02-24T19:11:00) I mean I'll have whatever there is, just suggesting the beans side would be nice
[6] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t5 @2025-02-24T18:55:00) My darlings 🥰 Adaora how is the thesis going? You have been so quiet this week and I know that means stress. Also before I forget, tell me what you want me to cook for Christmas. Emeka I know you want the goat 😂
[7] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-02-24T19:01:00) End of March is tight. Are you getting any proper breaks in? 😊 And yes Mum, goat and jollof obviously
[8] (about=Emeka, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:35:00) We'll figure it out when we're all together 😊 Mum there will be enough food for everyone regardless
[9] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:36:00) Ok. When you come home Adaora you will tell me everything ❤️ I am your mother
[10] (about=Ngozi, episodic, t8 @2025-03-03T20:29:00) Eating differently how?? 👀 Adaora what is going on
agent_answer:
Based on the conversation:

- **Ngozi** planned to cook the Christmas spread: **egusi, jollof, “the full thing,”** and she confirmed she would also make **moi moi** and have **goat** (Emeka’s requested dish).
- **Emeka** was happy with **goat and jollof** (“obviously”).
- **Adaora** asked for a beans side like **moi moi or akara**, but said she would “have whatever there is.” Later, however, she mentioned she is **“eating differently,”** which surprised Ngozi and was left unresolved; Emeka said they would “figure it out when we’re all together.”
- **Chidi** is not mentioned at all in the conversation, so there is no information about Chidi’s reaction.

So the plan was not fully finalized: Ngozi would cook the traditional spread, but Adaora’s different eating was still an open question, meaning **not everyone seemed equally settled on the plan**.
